annotations.title: Create or replace a Merchant Center product

description: Create or replace a product in a Merchant Center feed — this is how a merchant's catalogue gets populated, and it is what Shopping ads, free listings and retail Performance Max actually serve. It is an UPSERT and a WHOLE-ROW write: calling it again for the same offerId REPLACES the product rather than patching it, so send every field you want kept each time. You do not have to find a feed first — omit dataSource and it resolves the account's one writable feed, creates one if there is none, and REFUSES by name if there are several rather than putting the product in a market the campaigns may not target. offerId, contentLanguage and feedLabel together ARE the product's identity and are all immutable; contentLanguage and feedLabel are taken from the feed when the feed declares them. For the product to serve at all Google needs title, description, link, imageLink, availability and price — a row missing any of them is stored and then disapproved, and the reply says so rather than letting you believe it published. The reply reports what GOOGLE STORED, not what was sent. Free: a feed edit cannot spend.

additionalImageLinks.description: extra product image URLs, as a list

ageGroup.description: newborn, infant, toddler, kids or adult

attributes.description: any other product attribute by its Merchant API name — there are 145 and only the common ones are named above

contentLanguage.description: two-letter, e.g. "en" — taken from the feed when the feed declares one

customAttributes.description: extra attributes as a list of {name, value} objects

dataSource.description: the feed to write into, from list_merchant_data_sources. Omit to resolve the account's one writable feed (created if there is none, refused by name if there are several)

dataSourceName.description: display name for a feed created on the fly

description.description: product description; Google needs it for the product to serve

feedLabel.description: market bucket, e.g. "US" — taken from the feed when the feed declares one

identifierExists.description: false for a product with no GTIN/MPN/brand, such as a service or a bundle

imageLink.description: main product image URL (https); Google needs it for the product to serve

itemGroupId.description: shared id that groups the variants of one product, e.g. colours or sizes

link.description: the product page URL on the merchant's store

offerId.description: your own unique id for the product — IMMUTABLE, and what you update or delete it by later

price.description: price object: {value in major units or amountMicros, currencyCode}

amountMicros.description: micros, if you already have them — 1 unit = 1000000

productTypes.description: merchant-defined category labels for the product, as a list

salePrice.description: sale price, same shape as price

amountMicros.description: micros, if you already have them — 1 unit = 1000000

title.description: product title; Google needs it for the product to serve
